versions.text: Criterion: Verify that the air vehicle states in common environmental conditions have been defined and assessed for safety of flight. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 5.1.1 Primary requirements for air vehicle states in common environmental conditions. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, simulation and inspection of requirements, design, and configuration documentation.
